title: Person dimension row (canonical)
description: Logical contract for one row of datasets/elections/dim_persons.parquet. ADR-0035 S.1 renames dim_candidates to dim_persons and moves per-contest fields to elections_candidacies.parquet. Day-one person_id is Layer 1: one person per candidacy row, derived as sha256(state_code|ac_id|election_id|normalised_candidate_name)[:16], with a deterministic candidacy-key tiebreak when that base id repeats inside the corpus.

x-changelog.description: Initial dim_candidates schema (Phase 1.2b). Columns: candidate_id PK, ac_id, period_label, ballot_serial, name, party_id, rank, source_id. Historical entry retained here because v2.0 is a schema rename.
Additive dim_candidates bump adding optional party_short_raw for unresolved-party display fallback. Historical entry retained for migration trace.
Additive dim_candidates bump adding optional biographic columns: sex, age, education, profession, constituency_type, party_type. Historical entry retained for migration trace.

Breaking ADR-0035 S.1 persons fork. Rename dim_candidates to dim_persons, replace candidate_id PK with person_id PK, keep person-level display and biographic fields, and move per-contest fields to elections-candidacies.schema.json. id_aliases carries the retired dim-candidates schema id for one release window.

person_id.description: PK. ADR-0035 Layer-1 id for day one; future merge-overlay rows keep this stable when evidence is promoted.

display_name.description: Citizen-facing person name, verbatim from the issuing election row for Layer-1 identities. Null only when the upstream omitted a candidate name.

source_id.description: FK -> taxonomy/sources.parquet. Same ECI citation row that supports the candidacy row.

sex.description: Optional person-level biographic field. Null when not declared.

age.description: Optional candidate age at nomination. Lower bound follows the existing canonical bio contract. Null when not declared.

education.description: Optional Indian credential ladder. Null when blank.

profession.description: Optional profession category. Class distinctions such as Agriculture vs Agricultural Labour are preserved.
